thesis_summary.thesis: Altius Minerals Corporation is a Canadian royalty and streaming company listed on the TSX (ALS) and OTCQX (ATUSF). **[Fact]** It earns cash from long-life royalties and streams on base and battery metals, potash, iron ore, and renewable electricity, and runs a Project Generation business that seeds exploration partnerships and holds equity stakes. **[Fact]** The company also owns 57% of Altius Renewable Royalties (ARR) and holds a 29% interest in Generation Mining (GBR) through its joint-venture structure. **[Fact]** FY2025 attributable royalty revenue was **CAD 69.9 million** (**CAD 1.51 per share**), up from CAD 64.0 million in 2024 (`official-reports/nr_20260310_Q4_2025.pdf`). **[Fact]** About **46.3 million** common shares were outstanding after the Lithium Royalty Corp. (LRC) transaction (`official-reports/nr_20260310_Q4_2025.pdf`).
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The stock has more than doubled over the past year while headline net earnings are dominated by a one-time gain on the Arthur Gold royalty sale. **[Inference]** Investors may be paying a scarcity premium for diversified exposure to copper, potash, and Texas renewables without anchoring to **adjusted operating cash flow** of only **CAD 0.59 per share** in FY2025. **[Inference]** Horizon Kinetics (Q3 2025 commentary, **context tier only**) argued that Altius bundles hard-to-hold commodities at a small market cap; at **CAD 59.91** today the equity is far above the **~CAD 1.2 billion** frame in that letter, so the scarcity discount may have closed. **[Inference]** Project Generation equity marks and GBR development options are not fully visible in a single GAAP line, so both bulls and bears can misread the latent pipeline.
